In Session 2 she makes a point of saying she will respond to the parking consultation but only after the street has discussed it together — explicitly refusing to claim she speaks for everyone unilaterally. These two moments, one reactive and one proactive, show a consistent pattern: Sandra takes it personally when things happen without resident input, and equally holds herself to the same standard when acting on the group's behalf.
